sources.note: openFDA drugsfda applications with an approval dated 20260809 to 20261117, filtered locally to the matching submission.
Personal fields in the openFDA letter (representative, signatory, address) are not copied.
Monthly Orange Book zip. Headlines are NDA applications whose last unexpired listed protection falls within 75 days. Listed patents are not verified by FDA.

Changes section of October 2026 (https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/PurpleBook/2026/purplebook-search-October-data-download.csv). The full-database section of the file is not turned into headlines.
Meeting, amendment, postponement, and cancellation notices only. Nominations, renewals, and tobacco notices are dropped.
EMA daily medicines JSON. Variation decisions are not used; European Commission decision dates on already-authorised medicines are ignored. Source: European Medicines Agency.
Health Canada Notice of Compliance Database. Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada. Administrative and veterinary notices are dropped.
Europe PMC, the same API the site demo calls. Titles that assert efficacy or effectiveness are skipped. Crawl-delay on ebi.ac.uk is respected.
Read-only use of calendar/calendar.json. The ClinicalTrials.gov API is not called, because robots.txt disallows /api/. Study-page links are used. This job does not write calendar files.
clinicaltrials.gov robots.txt Disallow: /api/ for User-agent *. The populator does not call it. Study records already extracted into calendar/calendar.json are read locally.

Disabled. Written consent was requested on 2026-11-17 and has not been granted. Swissmedic terms require prior written consent for reproduction and prohibit automated extraction except on areas meant for it.
Disabled. Written consent was requested on 2026-11-17 and has not been granted. PMDA site policy says automated crawling or download applications are not permitted.
